title: ロジカルシンキング
subtitle: Logical Thinking
educationalGoal: This course deals with the way of logical thinking, especially for business purpose. Students will learn: (1) what are the basic concepts and the way of logical thinking. (2) how to make decisions or solve problems based on the logical thinking through many kinds of simple exercise.
advice: This is a basic course in logical thinking. Students will learn basic concepts of reasoning, logic, issues, critical thinking, claims, arguments, explanations, premises, conclusions, fact and opinion. We will cover the following topics: 1) Basics of formal logic and reasoning. 2) MECE (Mutually Exclusive and Collectively Exhaustive), Logic Tree, Pyramid Structure, and some Frameworks of logical thinking for business. 3) Fermi Estimation

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the inductive reasoning and deductive reasoning.
Be able to explain some frameworks for business.
Be able to draw a pyramid structure of the simple case.
Be able to make a solution of the simple case based on the way of logical thinking.
Be able to make a solution of the Fermi Estimation case.
